title: Relative distance calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the total distance the tourist travels relative to the ship as 200 meters.

title: Return distance relative
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the distance the tourist travels relative to the sea surface during the return trip as 400 meters.

title: Boat displacement symmetry
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize that the boat's displacement is equal during the tourist's forward and return trips due to constant speeds.

title: Relative velocity application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply relative motion concepts to relate the tourist's speed to the boat's displacement.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units (meters) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in displacement
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly adds instead of subtracts the ship's length when calculating the return distance relative to the sea.

title: Misinterpreting relative motion
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student confuses distances relative to the ship with distances relative to the sea surface.
